versions.subject: add win_pc_susp_schtasks_user_temp
versions.detection:
schtasks:
    Image|endswith: 'schtasks.exe'
option:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/Create '
        - '\AppData\Temp'
condition: schtasks and option

versions.subject: fix: several FPs against a fresh installed Windows with example applications and basic user interaction
versions.detection:
schtasks:
    Image|endswith: 'schtasks.exe'
option:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/Create '
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp'
filter_klite_codec:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/Create /TN "klcp_update" /XML '
        - '\klcp_update_task.xml'
condition: schtasks and option and not 1 of filter_*
